reasons.text: The legible label photo shows model 34692, which is a recalled model.
The label date code 10/2021 falls within the recalled range 10/2021-12/2022.
Purchased at Academy, a listed retailer, on 2019-10-22, inside the sale window; no receipt required.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this claim.
The claim requests repair or replacement, not a refund, and no destruction proof is required by the remedy; the refund threshold does not apply.
